ESCO Technologies: A Solid Business Model

ESCO Technologies is a global provider of highly-engineered products and solutions to diverse and growing end-markets that include the defense, aerospace, wireless, consumer electronics, healthcare, automotive, electric utility, and renewable energy industries. The company consists of three technology-driven business segments – Aerospace & Defense, Utility Solutions Group, and RF Test & Measurement.
ESCO consists of three Business Segments working to solve difficult technical challenges through superior engineering, precision manufacturing, and world class customer service.
Our highly-engineered products and solutions and continual focus on new product innovation result in market leadership positions in niche markets across each of our business segments.
Defined and Sustainable Competitive Advantage
The proprietary nature of our highly-engineered, technology-driven products and services results in sustainable recurring revenue and growth opportunities across a diverse group of end markets.

raw_blocks: ESCO Technologies at a Glance
ESCO Technologies consists of three business segments dedicated to solving difficult technical challenges through superior engineering, precision manufacturing, and world class customer service.
Quick-scroll to a category by choosing a link below:

Our Aerospace & Defense (A&D) companies provide highly-engineered hydraulic filtration systems, precision fluid control valves, machined components, and specialized metal finishing for aerospace applications. A&D also designs and manufactures complex shock and vibration dampening tiles, as well as signature and power management solutions that enhance the stealth capabilities of U.S. & U.K. Navy submarines and surface ships.
Visit the Crissair , ESCO Maritime , Globe , Mayday , PTI , and Westland websites.

Our Utility Solutions Group (USG) helps customers protect power networks through testing, monitoring, software, and expert support, ensuring safe, reliable energy for communities and businesses worldwide.
Visit the Doble , Megger , and NRG Systems websites.

Our RF Test & Measurement (Test) business is a leading provider of electromagnetic components and systems that measure and control RF energy for research and development, regulatory compliance, medical shielding, EMP protection, and security applications.
Visit ETS Lindgren , and MPE website.
